values.note: Reservations 'can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'. The Florida Forest Service closes every state forest campground when its county is under a Tropical Storm or Hurricane Warning, and refunds those reservations automatically.

note: Campground is reported to be quiet and peaceful with a nice sandy beach on the Withalacochee River; campsites are not waterfront.  --AWH River Junction Boat Ramp closed since June 6, 2026 for repairs and low water (FDACS, read 2026-10-21). --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica and FDACS: fee left as recorded ($13.76, read 2026-10-10); added year-round, 20 RV/tent sites to 35 ft (most 25 ft), no electric, potable water at each site, showers, ReserveAmerica booking with an 11-month window and the tropical-weather closure rule. AWH note kept; dated boat-ramp closure appended. Not stated: fcfs, stay limits, dump station.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: ReserveAmerica marks sites 001, 014 and 016 'Near Water' (and 014/016 'Water Hookup'); the entry and AWH's note say the campsites are not waterfront. AWH text left as is.
Name: the entry spells it 'Withalacochee'; ReserveAmerica and FDACS publish 'River Junction Campground Withlacoochee State Forest'.
No storm closure: Sumter County campground shows open; the FFS rule closes it only if the county goes under a Tropical Storm or Hurricane Warning (check again while Isaias is active).
